commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' A pass from Joel Asoro (Metz) is intercepted by Marco Bizot and the move breaks down.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' A player from Metz commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Brest in a dangerous position.
90' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) will take the corner.
90' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Metz will take a corner kick.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean N'Guessan (Metz) comes onto the pitch for Danley Jean Jacques.
87' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martin Satriano (Brest) replacing Steve Mounie.
85' Maxime Colin (Metz) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
82' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) serves up a nice cross, but Alexandre Oukidja punches the ball away.
81' The substitution has been made. Kevin N'Doram (Metz) has replaced Lamine Camara.
81' It's time for a substitution. Joel Asoro (Metz) comes on in place of Ablie Jallow.
80' Laszlo Boloni decides to make a substitution. Simon Elisor will be replaced by Benjamin Tetteh (Metz).

80' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Free kick. Metz will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
75' 0 - 1 Goal! Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) is teed up on the edge of the box by Kamory Doumbia, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:1.
72' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Mahdi Camara and he is replaced by Jonas Martin (Brest).
71' Today's match ends for Hugo Magnetti who will be replaced by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
71' The linesman raises his flag. Pape Diallo (Metz) is adjudged offside.
69' Rough tackle by Christophe Herelle (Metz). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Brest.
68' Ablie Jallow (Metz) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Marco Bizot. What a save!
67' The possession of the ball – 30:70.
65' Substitution. Pape Diallo (Metz) has come on for Cheikh Sabaly.
62' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Metz was in an offside position.
60' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Bilal Brahimi is replaced by Romain Del Castillo (Brest).
60' Substitution. Mathias Pereira Lage did his best and is replaced by Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest).
60' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' Ablie Jallow (Metz) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
59' Ablie Jallow (Metz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul. Brest get a free kick.
58' Mahdi Camara (Brest) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

56' Great solo effort by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
54' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) commits a foul and Romain Lissorgue immediately signals a free kick. Brest will take a free kick near the side line.
53' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Metz have a free kick.
51' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
48' Mahdi Camara (Brest) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul. Metz earn a free kick.
47' Bradley Locko (Brest) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' One of the Metz players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
44' Flag up against Simon Elisor (Metz). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
43' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
43' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. The ball goes out of play and Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Simon Elisor (Metz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Romain Lissorgue had an easy-decision to make.
41' The free kick is delivered by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
40' Christophe Herelle (Metz) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
39' Lamine Camara (Metz) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A mid-range free kick is awarded to Brest out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
39' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) commits a rough foul. Romain Lissorgue stops the game and makes a call. A free kick to Metz.
38' Neat passing move from Brest in order to create new attacking opportunities.
35' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Metz are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

33' Steve Mounie (Brest) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alexandre Oukidja, who pulls off a comfortable save!
31' The ball is crossed into the box and Lilian Brassier (Brest) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Alexandre Oukidja gets a glove on it to thwart him.
30' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Romain Lissorgue signals. Brest win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
29' The game is interrupted as Bilal Brahimi (Brest) is flagged offside.
28' Kenny Lala (Brest) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
26' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
25' Ablie Jallow (Metz) is first to the rebound and attempts to beat the keeper from long range. It's a decent effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
24' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
23' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Metz have a corner.
20' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul after Kenny Lala (Brest) hacks down one of his opponents. There is a free kick near the sideline to Metz.
18' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
16' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
15' The free kick is taken by Maxime Colin (Metz), but ball is cleared.
14' The game is interrupted now, Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
14' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) was quite harsh and Romain Lissorgue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
12' Bradley Locko (Brest) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
11' Bradley Locko (Brest) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

9' The game is interrupted. Ablie Jallow (Metz) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Brest are awarded the free kick.
8' Romain Lissorgue blows the whistle, Steve Mounie (Brest) is penalised for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Metz.
7' A cross by Mahdi Camara (Brest) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
5' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
4' Metz fail to score from a corner as Marco Bizot (Brest) leaps to collect the ball.
3' The ball is cleared after Simon Elisor (Metz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Now Metz have a corner.
2' Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to Kenny Lala (Brest) for his blatant foul.
1' Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Metz will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Romain Lissorgue.
